title: Chinese Hackers Impersonate Anthropic Employee to Extract AI Secrets
key_facts: Proofpoint, a US cybersecurity firm, reports a group it calls TA419 impersonated AI professionals, including an Anthropic staffer and an ex-White House official.
Targets were AI policy experts at US think tanks, universities and law firms.
Emails invited targets to a made-up 'AI Policy Advisory Committee' or a fictional Senate report, then sent malware-laced documents aimed at cloud accounts.
One email used the subject 'Request for Feedback on Military Integration of Claude'.
Proofpoint researcher Mark Kelly told CNN the group is 'Chinese government-aligned' based on targeting, infrastructure, technical artifacts and industry partners.
Lynne Edwards Parker, formerly of the White House OSTP, was among those impersonated.
Proofpoint expects the campaigns to continue.
quote_evidence: We are confident," Mark Kelly, a Proofpoint researcher, told CNN, that the hacking cohort is a "Chinese government-aligned threat actor
These campaigns will likely also continue spoofing the identities of real subject-matter experts.
why_it_matters_hint: Impersonation of AI-lab staff to reach policy experts and their cloud accounts.
event_date: Proofpoint report, date not stated (reported 4 Oct 2026)
notes: Futurism relays Proofpoint and CNN; Proofpoint original not read. Attribution to China is Proofpoint's assessment.
